hooks.command: test -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/art30-record.json" || { rm -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.art30-hook-attempts"; exit 0; }; n=$(cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.art30-hook-attempts" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) n=0;; esac; [ "$n" -ge 3 ] && { rm -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.art30-hook-attempts"; exit 0; }; out=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run --project /absolute/path/to/art30 python /absolute/path/to/skill/art30/scripts/verify.py --repo . --record ./art30-record.json 2>&1); status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then rm -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.art30-hook-attempts"; exit 0; fi; printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; if [ $status -eq 1 ]; then echo $((n+1)) > "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.art30-hook-attempts"; exit 2; fi; rm -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.art30-hook-attempts"; exit 1
